timelapse.title: Ghana at night, 2012–2025
timelapse.alt: Animated satellite map of Ghana at night from 2012 to 2025: lights spread out from Accra, Kumasi and Tamale and along the main roads.

before_after.title: Before and after: 2012 and 2025
before_after.alt: A curtain sweeps across the map of Ghana at night, revealing 2025 over 2012: far more of the country is lit.

cover.title: Night-time Lights and Development in Ghana
cover.alt: Title image with the satellite map of Ghana at night in 2025.

source: Source: GSS computations from VIIRS night-time lights (Earth Observation Group, Colorado School of Mines).
